en.html:
Iwata"This building is for your use."
Ichijou"Eh? This whole place? All of it?"
Iwata"Until recently, a guard post. As accommodation it is rather cramped. You may suffer some inconvenience."
Kageaki"Quite sufficient. Being apart from the other residences is useful."
Iwata"Yes, that was considered in the arrangements. Conversations here will not be overheard."
Iwata"Even so, please do not become careless."
Kageaki"Understood. One question."
Iwata"Yes?"
Kageaki"How are we to contact you from now on?"
Iwata"Ask for Yoryuudo Iwata at the Mandokoro. Officially, you both work under me. No need to hide the fact that we meet."
Kageaki"Understood."
Iwata"Anything further?"
Ichijou"Um... actually..."
Iwata"Yes?"
Ichijou"Minato sir and me, staying here together—isn't that a bit odd? For the cover, I mean. People will look, no?"
Iwata"No difficulty. You are entered together. One Arata unit."

Iwata"...These quarters are not built like the fortress walls or the keep. Please do not test the pillars with your forehead."
Kageaki"You heard her, Ichijou."
Ichijou"B-but—but—ONE unit!? Have I become an attached document!?"
Kageaki"You did not know?"
Ichijou"Kisne bataya!? Who told me!? Nobody!"
Kageaki"We gave our aliases the same surname."
Ichijou"Same name, two people! I didn't know you'd bundled us into one entry!"
Kageaki"Two separate entries could mean two separate lodgings. Inconvenient."
Ichijou"Haan, that part I understand! But still!"
Kageaki"You object?"
Ichijou"Eh... what?"
Kageaki"To being put under one cover with me. Is there an objection?"
Ichijou"N-not... I didn't mean..."
Kageaki"I object."

Kageaki"In any case, we will begin work immediately."
Iwata"Beginning with what?"
Kageaki"Information. The people and facilities inside the fortress, we must examine with our own eyes and ears."
Kageaki"After that comes the plan."
Iwata"Yes. That would be sensible."

Iwata"Easily. Some official business will give you a reason to call on him. Meanwhile, please have a bath."
Kageaki"I see... particular about personal presentation?"
Iwata"Yes. Documents arriving with a young lady smelling of horse dung, I expect he would take badly."

en.html:
Once Ichijou had bathed, I took the papers from Ms. Iwata and entered Fudaraku Fortress's main enclosure. Ordinary routine reports, nothing remarkable. But they needed the administrator's seal.

Excellent excuse. Whatever else one could say about that agent, she worked quickly and without loose ends. We could meet Doushin Yusa—the shogunate's current administrator, and the only Kubo still in the fortress—without anything looking suspicious.

en.html:
Even beside royalty and nobility in other countries, they exposed very little of themselves.

Probably, in their own minds, ruling Yamato was still a military operation in progress.

The peacetime obligation of the rich—supplying the public with something to gossip about—could wait. First become Yamato's sole and absolute rulers. Then attend to this important service.

Pehle desh pakdo. First get the whole country into the fist. Only afterward open one little finger and permit the public to admire it. What His Excellency ate for breakfast, for example. At present, His Excellency was still occupied with eating the country.

After spilling a great deal of blood. Or while continuing to spill it.

Ichijou and I were here to prevent precisely that outcome.
